name: Kobayashi Kyouko
source: Kyoko-Sensei loves parties, and has one at every occasion. Shuji's homeroom teacher, Kyoko-Sensei loves sake and beer and drinks whenever she has an excuse.
translation: Kyoko-Sensei loves parties, and has one at every occasion. Shuji's homeroom teacher, Kyoko-Sensei loves sake and beer and drinks whenever she has an excuse.
